# SerpPrism

> Free SEO and website auditing tools that run entirely in the browser. No upload, no signup.

## Tools
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate clean page title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags. Live length warnings and copy-ready HTML, all in your browser.
- [SERP Preview Tool](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/serp-preview): Preview how your title and description look in Google results, measured in real pixels. See exactly where the snippet gets truncated before you publish.
- [robots.txt Tester](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/robots-txt-tester): Paste a robots.txt and test any URL against any user-agent. See exactly which rule wins, which line matched, and whether Googlebot can crawl the page.
- [Heading Structure Analyzer](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/heading-analyzer): Paste HTML and get a clean H1–H6 outline plus a list of real problems: missing or duplicated H1, skipped levels, and headings that are too long.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/keyword-density): Count single words and two- or three-word phrases with stopwords filtered out. See frequency, percentage, and which phrases are worth targeting.
- [Readability Score Checker](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/readability-score): Measure Flesch Reading Ease, grade level, sentence length and passive voice. See which specific sentences are dragging the score down.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/llms-txt-generator): Build a valid llms.txt file — the plain-text index that tells AI crawlers what your site offers. Runs entirely in your browser.
- [JSON-LD Schema Markup Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid JSON-LD for Article, FAQ, HowTo, Product, BreadcrumbList and Organization. Fill in fields, get copy-ready markup that validates.
- [UTM Link Builder](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/utm-link-builder): Build campaign URLs with correctly encoded utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign. Live validation catches the mistakes that split your analytics data.
- [Open Graph Preview Tool](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/open-graph-preview): Preview the card LinkedIn, Facebook, X and Slack render for your link. Get the Open Graph and Twitter tags that produce it, plus checks for image mistakes.
- [hreflang Tag Generator](https://www.serpprism.com/tools/hreflang-generator): Generate hreflang annotations as HTML link tags, an HTTP Link header, or sitemap entries — with validation for bad language codes and missing return tags.

## Guides
- [Meta Description Length: What Gets Truncated](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/meta-description-length): The number everyone quotes is 155 characters. The real rule is pixel width, and knowing the difference saves you from rewriting descriptions that were fine.
- [robots.txt Mistakes That Silently Deindex Pages](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/robots-txt-mistakes): Five configuration errors that remove pages from Google without producing any error message anywhere.
- [Heading Structure: What H1–H6 Order Actually Does](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/heading-structure-seo): Headings are document structure, not a ranking lever. Here is what they genuinely affect, and what is folklore.
- [JSON-LD @graph: Why One Block Beats Five](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/json-ld-graph-structure): Most sites emit one JSON-LD block per schema type and never connect them. A single @graph with @id references fixes the duplication.
- [A Pre-Publish SEO Checklist for Any New Page](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/pre-publish-seo-checklist): Nine checks that take under ten minutes and catch the mistakes that are invisible after publishing. Ordered so that the cheap ones come first.
- [What 71 Sites Actually Put in robots.txt](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/robots-txt-in-the-wild): We fetched the robots.txt of 78 high-traffic sites. A quarter declare no sitemap at all, and five still ship a directive Google ignores.
- [What 61 Homepages Actually Ship in JSON-LD](https://www.serpprism.com/guides/json-ld-in-the-wild): We parsed the JSON-LD on 61 homepages. Half ship none in their HTML, and 14 still carry markup for a feature Google retired in 2024.

## Notes for automated readers
All processing is client-side JavaScript. There is no API; tool behaviour is deterministic given the same input.
